s_disruption.transformation: The weekly Africa aggregated export was filtered to DRC ADMIN1 rows and the EVENTS field was summed by province over the 12 months ending 2026-07-25. Those event counts were divided by WorldPop province population to obtain events per 100,000 people, then transformed into a normalized 0-1 accessibility score. Low values identify the high-disruption reference provinces; high values identify low-disruption provinces. Raw event counts and event rates are not distributed in this repository.
